text:
ashok: Heads-up: eu-west1 backlog for redwood-v1-medium spiked after the 06:00 deploy. Queue depth ~4200, p95 queue wait ~18s, GPUs in pool eu-west1-ptl at 96% util :rotating_light:

sophie: ack. Any single-tenant causing it or many models?

ashok: Looks multi-tenant but concentrated on a few heavy gen jobs. Per-model breakdown shows redwood-v1-medium and rwd-v1-qa ~65% of queued work. Non-enterprise customers account for ~48% of incoming qps.

leo: autoscaler didn't add nodes — threshold stayed at 85% and we have max nodes set low for eu-west1 to save cost. Can we temporarily lift max-nodes?

ashok: Autoscaler logs show hitting max_nodes for the pool: `max_nodes: 24`. We have a pending capacity request to pool-owners but that's slow.

tim: Short-term mitigations: 1) tighten admission control for non-enterprise tenants 2) shift lower-priority traffic to us-west2 3) apply temporary model-level concurrency limits.

sophie: I'm in favor of 1+3. How do we flip admission rules live?

ashok: We can patch the admission config in k8s for gateway: `kubectl -n inference patch cm admission-config --patch '{"data":{"max_inflight_per_tenant":"20","max_inflight_per_model":"150"}}'` — that's what we tried in staging.

infra-bot: deploy triggered: admission-config update queued (change id: ad-2026-0412-01).

leo: Also suggest weight-based routing: deprioritize `rwd-v1-qa` by lowering its scheduler weight to 0.6. Command: `curl -X POST $ORCH/routing/weights -d '{"model":"rwd-v1-qa","weight":0.6,"region":"eu-west1"}'`

tim: Good. I'll open a short-lived rate-limit for free tier: `ratelimit set --tenant-class free --qps 1 --region eu-west1 --ttl 2h`

sophie: Can we also enable fallback to CPU-backed cheap instances for embeddings-only paths? That reduces GPU load for certain requests.

ashok: Yes, enabling CPU fallback for embeddings and short chats now. Patch applied. We'll watch metrics.

infra-bot: admission-config update applied (ad-2026-0412-01). cpu-fallback toggle: true.

ashok: Early signal: queue depth decreased to ~2700, p95 wait dropped to ~9s. GPU util down to 88%. Still above normal but trending better.

leo: Action items: - sophie: keep routing weight change for rwd-v1-qa for next 1h then evaluate - tim: rate-limit rollback plan if error rates rise - ashok: follow up with pool-owners about raising max_nodes or adding burst capacity

ashok: I'll also schedule a postmortem to decide longer-term: adjust autoscaler guardrails, add rapid-burst capacity, and improve per-model backpressure heuristics. Assigning owners in the incident board. :white_check_mark:

sophie: noting that this is the third similar spike in the last 6 weeks; we need better predictive signals (model-level qps trends).

tim: I'll add a metric in console: `per_model_queue_trend` and an alert at 10% week-over-week increase.

ashok: Thanks all — monitoring continues. Ping me if you see >80% GPU util or queue >3k again.
